# Enterprise Templates

## Overview

The **Enterprise Templates** department provides standardized templates used throughout the ForgeOS ecosystem.

Templates ensure that engineering, architecture, operations, security, AI and governance artifacts are created with consistent structure, metadata and quality.

Every enterprise document should begin from an approved template rather than being created from scratch.

ForgeOS adopts a **Template-Driven Engineering** approach where standardization accelerates delivery, improves governance and enables AI-assisted document generation.

---

# Objectives

The Enterprise Templates aim to:

- Standardize enterprise documentation
- Improve engineering consistency
- Reduce documentation effort
- Increase governance compliance
- Enable AI-assisted content generation
- Improve audit readiness
- Strengthen traceability
- Accelerate enterprise delivery

---

# Scope

Templates apply to:

- Standards
- SOPs
- Playbooks
- Policies
- Runbooks
- Architecture Documents
- ADRs
- API Specifications
- Design Documents
- Product Documents
- Security Reports
- AI Documentation
- Operational Reports

---

# Core Principles

## Consistency First

All enterprise documents shall follow approved templates.

---

## Metadata by Default

Every template shall include standardized metadata.

---

## AI Ready

Templates shall be structured for:

- Enterprise Search
- RAG
- AI Assistants
- AI Agents
- Automated Documentation

---

## Documentation as Code

Templates shall be version controlled and maintained using Git.

---

## Continuous Improvement

Templates shall evolve based on engineering feedback, governance updates and organizational learning.

# Template Overview

## TMP-001 — Standard Template

Standard template for enterprise standards, governance documents and organization-wide policies.

---

## TMP-002 — SOP Template

Template for Standard Operating Procedures with repeatable workflows, roles, approvals and quality gates.

---

## TMP-003 — Playbook Template

Template for operational playbooks including triggers, execution steps, escalation paths and recovery procedures.

---

## TMP-004 — Architecture Template

Template for solution architecture, system design and enterprise architecture documentation.

---

## TMP-005 — ADR Template

Architecture Decision Record template used to document strategic and technical decisions.

---

## TMP-006 — API Specification Template

Standard template for REST, GraphQL and event-driven API documentation.

---

## TMP-007 — Project Template

Template for project initiation, planning, execution, governance and closure documentation.

---

## TMP-008 — Risk Assessment Template

Template for enterprise risk assessments including impact analysis, mitigation planning and governance.

---

## TMP-009 — Runbook Template

Template for operational procedures covering routine maintenance, troubleshooting and recovery activities.

---

## TMP-010 — AI Documentation Template

Template for documenting AI systems, prompts, models, datasets, evaluations and governance controls.

---

# Common Metadata

Every template shall include:

- Document ID
- Title
- Version
- Status
- Owner
- Classification
- Created Date
- Updated Date
- Reviewers
- Related Documents
- Tags

Metadata shall support enterprise search and AI indexing.

---

# Standard Document Sections

Templates should include the following sections where applicable:

- Executive Summary
- Purpose
- Scope
- Guiding Principles
- Requirements
- Roles and Responsibilities
- Workflow or Lifecycle
- Quality Gates
- KPIs
- Governance
- Implementation Notes
- AI Consumption Notes
- References
- Change History

Templates may extend this structure to meet domain-specific requirements.

---

# Versioning

Templates shall follow Semantic Versioning:

```
MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
```

Template updates shall be communicated to all affected departments.

---

# Governance

Enterprise Templates operate under the authority of the **Enterprise Architecture Board** and the **Knowledge Management Office**.

Changes affecting:

- Metadata Structure
- Document Layout
- Mandatory Sections
- Naming Standards
- AI Metadata

shall require governance approval before publication.

---

# AI Integration

Templates are optimized for:

- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Semantic Search
- Enterprise Knowledge Bases
- AI Agents
- Enterprise Copilots
- Automated Documentation Pipelines

Structured metadata shall maximize AI retrieval accuracy.

---

# Future Vision

The ForgeOS Template Library aims to become:

- Fully Standardized

- Enterprise Searchable
- Self Validating
- Audit Ready
- Continuously Improved
- Organization Wide
